visualReview: Dashboard prioritizes the referral above quieter summary cards and a flat activity list.
Timeline uses a temporal rail, category markers, month dividers and a distinct referral route.
Records retain source metadata and reduce actions to View, Explain and overflow.
Selected history and exact four-record package remain immediately distinguishable.
Consent names both providers, preserves the unselected checkbox, and emphasizes private excluded history.
All desktop, mobile and journey outputs share Manrope, semantic colors, restrained surfaces and Lucide icons.
reviewScope: Static visual and rendered-text review; not clinical validation, user testing or accessibility certification of a working application.
